newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to seek 111-09 on way to 112-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to seek 111-09 on way to 112-00.

text.p: September T-bond futures will remain positive on Wednesday and seek to overcome 111-09, before a test of 112-00, technical analysts said.

"The uptrend is still intact and the declining channel at the moment is just corrective," said Reynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London. "We look for an upside break initially to 111-09, and then 112-00."
He said the base of the declining channel came in at 110-10 and the top at 110-27.
At 1106 GMT September T-bond futures were at 110-22, up 5/32 on the day in automated trade.
Daily charts show 111-09 was the high on June 6 and 112-00 was the low on February 21.
To the downside Cheng said stronger support below 110-10 came in at 110-04, the high on June 3.
But some analysts did not see much further upside potential for T-bonds and saw the contract nearing the top of its range.
Gerry Celaya, technical analyst at American Express Bank in London said T-bonds had consolidated on Tuesday and looked set for further consolidation during this session.
"A bearish base is still in place for a turn through 110-09 for 110-00 and lower," he said in a research note.
But if 110-09 held, it increased the market potential to work towards 111-00, 111-09, Celaya said.
At the short end September Eurodollars were at 94.030, up 0.005 on the day, while the December contract was at 93.825, up 0.015.
